absent: Locking and concurrency rules for exit handlers, MMU, APIC and run state.
Full layouts of vcpu, virtualized CPU, nested VMCS, run area and VMCS field encodings.
Implementation of delegated emulation, fault queueing, skip helpers, tracing, split lock and machine check paths.
Numeric ABI values for exit reasons, vectors, qualifications, controls and error masks.
Behavior of external interrupt, interrupt window, halt, power, hypercall and other table targets not routed here.

findings.text: A reason indexed table selects the handler for each VM exit class covering exception and NMI events, external interrupts, triple fault, control and debug register activity, descriptor operations, TLB and APIC events, task switches, memory faults, pause and monitor behavior, virtualization instructions, bus lock, notify and immediate register accesses.

Handlers signal continuation with a positive result to reenter the guest and zero to stop in host userspace, with a negative host error for impossible configuration; zero is used for debug, architectural exception, shutdown, TPR and conditional notify reports while injected faults, skipped instructions and pure bookkeeping stay positive.

Exception and NMI exits first ignore machine check and NMI for other paths, queue device not available faults early with extended feature error state when relevant, delegate invalid opcode elsewhere, and treat virtualization exception as unexpected with diagnostics.

The same path reads an error code only when hardware marks one present, emulates a narrow zero code general protection case for a legacy virtual hardware backdoor, reports coincident vectoring and exit events as host internal error with four diagnostic words, and otherwise delegates page faults.

Remaining vectors consult virtual 8086 mode first, then either queue breakpoint style faults for the guest or publish debug state and program counter to host userspace when guest debugging is active, apply alignment check injection and split lock handling, and by default publish exception number plus error code to host userspace.

Triple fault publishes a shutdown report to host userspace and clears pending memory operation state, while port input output exits count a statistic and either emulate string operations or decode port number width and direction for a fast host path.

Nested control register writes preserve hypervisor owned bits by combining the incoming value with saved guest state under a mask, apply the combined value through the generic setter, and on success record the original guest value in the read shadow; non nested writes go directly to the generic setter.

Control register exits decode target register, general register and operation kind from exit qualification, supporting move to control registers zero three four and eight with completion translation, move from three and eight with skip, low nibble status word handling, host failure on clear task switched flag, and an unimplemented report otherwise with special userspace priority notification when lowering priority without kernel local APIC.

Debug register exits validate the register number, translate a general detect trap into either host userspace debug state or a queued guest breakpoint fault, enforce supervisor privilege, disable further trapping and request register reload when guest debugging is off, and otherwise move values to or from architectural debug state with completion translation.

Debug registers four and five are accepted unconditionally except that undefined opcode is queued when the debug extensions enable is clear, expressing aliasing of those registers only under that control.

TLB invalidation applies guest address invalidation then skips the instruction; APIC exits provide a fast end of interrupt shortcut, accelerated end of interrupt without program counter change, and trap like write handling where hardware has already updated the virtual page and only register emulation remains.

Task switch exits decode reason and vectoring type, clear pending interrupt or exception state according to whether the switch came from interrupt, exception with optional code, soft event or NMI with mask handling, advance past the triggering instruction except for selected hardware event types, then invoke generic task switching with selector, vector and error context.

Extended page table violations restore NMI blocking when unblocking is indicated without valid vectoring under virtual NMI, trace fault address and qualification, emulate when the physical address exceeds legal limits under a compatibility mode, and otherwise delegate to the common violation handler.

Pause handling grows the spin loop window when pauses stay in the guest and accounts spin before skipping; monitor trap and page log full are positive no operation paths with log full also restoring NMI blocking; invalidate process context identifier checks guest capability and fetches its memory operand before delegation; NMI window and threshold paths clear controls, count statistics and request event evaluation or priority update.

Virtualization, trust domain and secure enclave instructions all inject undefined opcode; bus lock exits only record detection for later handling; notify exits restore NMI blocking, count a statistic and either publish a notify report with invalid context marking when configured or invalid, or resume; immediate register read delegates with qualification and register selector. Descriptor exits assume user mode instruction prevention cannot be guest owned.

Host userspace reports use symbolic exit reasons for debug with program counter exception debug registers and length, architectural exception with vector and code, internal error with four diagnostic words for coincident events, shutdown, priority change and conditional notify with invalid context flag, plus associated vector and control names.

Unexpected virtualization exception, coincident vectored and exit exceptions, guest ownership violation of task switched flag, NMI window without virtual NMI support, unhandled control operation, and real mode general protection without backdoor enable are treated as host warnings or failures rather than silent guest behavior.
